caption: The drawing displays a single ceramic jar that is centrally placed and rendered in a realistic style. The jar is shaped with a round, slightly flared mouth and a broad body that tapers down toward the base. The lip of the jar is a reddish-brown, while the body has an overall olive-brown coloration with subtle variations, including some yellow, green, and brown hues, and shaded areas to indicate reflected light and form. Two small, ridged handles are attached symmetrically on opposite sides of the upper portion of the jar. The jar appears glossy, as evidenced by reflected highlights on its surface. The background is plain, off-white, with a faint rectangular outline surrounding the jar to frame it within the composition. There is minimal text, with a scale written as “Scale 3/4 = 1” at the bottom left and a signature at the bottom right.
title: Preserving Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
